verdict.rationale: Databricks Metric Views (Unity Catalog semantics) let analysts define metrics, dimensions, and joins once — 'you define the metric once... users can group by any available field. The query engine generates the correct computation' — and these views are queryable consistently from AI/BI dashboards, Genie, and external BI tools like Power BI, Tableau, and Sigma, ensuring consistent answers across query and AI surfaces. This directly matches the governed semantic-layer story with first-party documentation of the declarative model, governance under Unity Catalog, and cross-tool consumption. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of consistency in practice and more detail on join declaration beyond metric/dimension examples.
